Title: IATAH for leaving my family and starting over
Post Content:
This is my (24M) half ass attempt at peer therapy. And, trust me I know, IATAH.  About 6 months ago I left my Girlfriend(28F) and my 2 year old son. 

I was in the process of moving to LA from the Midwest for my business. I was unhappy in my relationship, I felt that whatever I did wasn’t enough, I was tired of arguing, our intimate life was suffering, everything just felt like a day to day chore.  We didn’t sleep in the same bed for 2 years.  I always slept on the couch.  Basically everything just lost its spark.  

Right after I moved I decided to call it quits, I broke up with her over the phone, I signed a newly remodeled completely paid off house into her name, I signed over a 2021 Jeep Cherokee also completely paid off in her name.  And I left.  I didn’t abandon my son, I fly back once a month for a week to visit and I try to call everyday but it’s hard. Because she’s so sad, he can’t really communicate over the phone and in the background all I can hear is her crying.  We were together since I was 17 and she was 22 so I know it’s hard for her and I do care so deeply but I’m already doing too much damage. 

I held onto a lot of past trauma, she cheated on me and disrespected me twice in the first couple years of our relationship.  I forgave her but never truly did which was wrong in my part.  Either I should have completely forgiven her or left, leaving would’ve been the smartest choice. But I didn’t we stuck together and I would say we got past it for the most part but of course we both harbored a little resentment.   Basically I bottled my emotions up for years.  I would try to talk to her about issues but she never wanted to communicate, and then I would get angry.  I only really ever got a response when I got angry.  We never put hands on each other but we would share foul words and it hurts worse when you know everything about each other and you’re supposed to love each other right. 

After I left I completely justified it by repeating these things in my head.

I’m very financially stable for my age, I support my whole family and hers if they need it.  I own multiple residential and commercial properties.  I own a distribution company, and a retail smokeshop.  I lost both of my parents to drug addiction at 19 and it gave me a very fierce ambition to support my family, we grew up in absolute poverty.   I did 3 years and 8 months in a juvenile prison(14-17)  I lost all my childhood, I didn’t play sports or have time with peers.  And when I got out of prison my Grandmother was losing her house because I was turning 18and she wouldn’t be receiving checks for the adoption(took my brother and I in as kids.)  So I used my time in prison to learn, my mom was in prison at the time too.  She was studying paralegal, so I used my time to study real estate and business.  Deep down I had hoped we would get out and become a team but that didn’t happen.  

I met her right after I got out of prison, and I was infatuated.  We had the same friend group, she actually hated me growing up which was funny.  But we basically jumped straight in, our first night together was at her apt (I was living w my grandma still) and after that night I had never left, we got a house together and she stuck by my side while I had to make something happen.  She always questioned me and expressed doubt but for the most part she was supportive. She was there for me through a lot.  My mom was murdered via Hotshot, she witnessed her last breaths with me.  She held me while I laid on the hospital floor and bawled. She made pictures and christmas ornaments for her. And tried to keep her alive as much as possible.  She still does, even though I’m not around she still tells our son about Grandma and it warms my soul. Hell she still has my mom on the kitchen counter and is watching over her for me.  We were together 4 years when she got pregnant.  I was already well off but still working towards more.  She expressed that she wanted to have an abortion.  I’m not against abortion, but at the time I felt like if we were to abort our child and not start a family then what were we doing this for, so I old her that it was fine but I wouldn’t be comfortable staying in the relationship.  So she had him so I would stay.  Which is so selfish of me, I just never had a true family and I felt that’s what I wanted with all my heart.  And I do not regret it I love my son so much, he’s so smart and a spitting image of the both of us it’s crazy. But it was selfish.  She sacrificed her body and future for a family with me.  

Right after the baby was born my work picked up ten fold.  I would work 12 hour days at my office, 7 days a week. I was the boss I wanted to be a role model for my employees.  It created more turmoil in our relationship, because now I have a newborn son and girlfriend going through post partum and all I’m doing is working 24/7.  And when I was home I was exhausted but hey we’re pulling in 50k a week so everyone should be happy right? Wrong. But growing up in such poverty I couldn’t put my mind on that.  I came home from the hospital to blankets in a dresser drawer, my son had a whole themed bedroom.  All my young mind could think about was the fact that I had offered him and my girlfriend so much more than my parents offered me in such a short time.  I would shower them with gifts, but not time. And she was very adamant that that’s what she wanted was time.  We would argue about me working constantly and I would get upset and in my mind would think that she didn’t want me to be as successful as I could be. But that wasn’t the case, she just wanted a regular family.  I’m bipolar by the way, sounds crazy but I don’t take meds because manic episodes actually let me get a ton done, but it does affect my thinking patterns a bit.   
But basically I just wanted to make more more more, and she wanted me to sit back and take it easy.  

Well I got an offer to run a facility in Southern California, it was my lifelong dream so I took it.  I thought back on all our issues and at the time I was on a high (manic not drugs) I thought it was time for me to start fresh. I broke up with her I moved downtown and I started networking, promoting the business but also try to make friends at the same time. I was lonely I spent my first month doing nothing but work on my laptop. 

The first night I went out was my birthday, there was a bar across the street from my apt so I decided I might as well go and get some drinks, I had a good time met a bunch of people, including a girl.  And this girl was exactly my type she was funny and gorgeous she dressed well, she was involved in the same business as me and she was just a great person.  We talked for a bit that night she had recently gotten out of a relationship and had just moved tot he area a month before me.  That first night we hit it off real well, she took me to an after party and introduced me to the people that she had met already.  I ended up in a penthouse playing connect 4 w her damn near all night.  At the end of the night (early morning) we went our separate ways.  I knew I wanted to see her again, and at the time I had no remorse for my ex. This was my fresh start. 

I went out again the next day and ran into her, it really was my only intention for going out, we ended up spending another drunken night talking all night basically, she explained to me both her parents were dead, we laughed about it bc yanno how it be, you can’t laugh with everyone about trauma.   I learned more about her and she learned a little bit more about me.  Fast forward a couple weeks and we were still just friends we didn’t have sex or do romantic things together but we would hangout when we saw each other and I kind of joined her friend group a little bit. I had a job come up that I needed extra hands on, so I offered it to her as a temporary thing and she agreed.  She came over to my apartment and we worked alongside each other for a good week or so, nothing happened but once again we learned more about each other.  She told me that it was funny the building I lived in was named after her deceased dad, it was super ironic.  But things like that kept popping up.  I used her card for her one day and her pin was my birthday, I asked why and she said that it was her lunch code growing up and we laughed about it.  I’m also really into numerology after my mom died, and 444 has been one number I followed everywhere and it’s almost always lead me to success. (I chalk up a lot of my success to luck)  I kept noticing it everywhere when I was with her.  (Even my new apt number was 404 and I was on the 4th floor.) 
It’s a little eccentric but it meant something to me. 


I’m a signs person for sure and all signs were pointing to her, at least that what my manic brain was saying.  I still believe it tbh.  So I took a shot and we’ve been together now about 3 months since the beginning of the year.  She went on a cross country trip with me, we shared a new years kiss in a Chicago nightclub.  We watched shows in Vegas and got tattoos together on the Fremont strip.  We stayed in Oklahoma and went to country dive bars with her brother, we made love on the kitchen counter of a snowed in mansion in the Ozarks.  We shared stories and laughs and I think I had the best time of my life with her. She took me to see her hometown in the redwoods, she introduced me to the only real piece of family she has left. We stayed in their spare bedroom and sat up and laughed all night.  It’s been nothing but amazing until lately. 

I had a business trip to go back to Vegas and meet up with some employees from back home, I decided to bring my new girlfriend with, we have been basically inseparable since we made it official.  While out there I ate some mushrooms, we had the intentions of going back to Fremont and people watching(it’s something we do)  but I ended up having a bad trip.  I went back to the hotel and just sat up and cried, I had realized that maybe I had never made these connections with the mother of my child because we didn’t try. 

I never took her on cross country trips where we could try to reconcile our love, we didn’t go on dates anymore bc I was so busy and we had a newborn, our intimate life was failing because I wasn’t putting forth enough effort.  The house that I bought and fixed up for our family was going to be lived in by another man because I wanted to start fresh.   I sent her a message saying these things expressing my doubt and my new girlfriend saw it, she was very upset and basically told me if I was unsure I should have never made it so serious we could have taken it easy. And she’s right, she also told me she loved me and supported whatever decision I made.  I know that these feelings are probably normal and that it might not change the relationship if I go back.i could be just as miserable and sacrificing an actual good communicative relationship. (That I don’t deserve in the first place).  I’m so lost in my mind because I truly have so much love for my new girlfriend, she’s everything I’ve dreamed of, even our argument was communicative and I’m not used to that.  She’s so open with me, and expects the same in return.  The mother of my child knows about my new girlfriend and she calls her names and makes derogatory remarks but she doesnt mean it she’s just hurt. She’s willing to take me back but I’m lost and don’t know what to do.  I could really try to be the partner and father she wants me to be.  Or I could focus on building a better relationship with my son being 2000 miles away.  My new girlfriend has made it known she’s willing to go back with me to my home state so I can be closer to my son. 

I know I’m the asshole, I’m very very aware.  I beat myself up everyday because no matter what now I have to break one heart, and i don’t even know if my last relationship is truly repairable after all this damage.  I completely support the mother of my child still, and to be honest I could continue until my son is 18 with no worrries financially.  I’m not worried about her struggling, I also do spend a week out of the month with my son, I didn’t abandon him, daddy just lives far away. I’m sorry for the long rant I could probably keep going but ive trauma dumped enough.

Title: AITAH for getting angry with my husband for not celebrating a huge achievement
Post Content:
I (f30) recently got into the PhD program of my dreams with very generous funding. I was thrilled. I live far from my parents so we haven’t been able to celebrate as a family, though i did call them. Here’s the thing: it’s been around 2 weeks and my husband (M31) hasn’t done anything to celebrate my achievement. He was excited for me and hugged me when he found out, though I’ve mostly just been experiencing the joy by myself since he works and is also in school. 

Today i was supposed to celebrate by going out with some friends. A few of them couldn’t end up making it. The kicker is that my husband is behind on an assignment, and he also cancelled, saying he needs to stay home to finish and submit his schoolwork. I understand the importance of school work (i am going for my PhD after all, and it took long hours and hard work to get here). However, he hasn’t gotten me flowers, made me dinner or even written me a little note celebrating me. Now he can’t make it to my celebration (which we ended up tentatively rescheduling because so many people cannot come). 

Here’s the thing - i got pretty upset, blaming his time management. I said I’m disappointed he can’t come and that i feel unsupported. He said “we can do our own thing” and i said while that would be nice, I’m still feeling let down by him and my other friends who can’t make it. He then seemed to get upset that I’m focusing on his shortcomings and not the fact that he said we can do our own thing. He said he wanted to surprise me, but that i have no faith in him so it wasn’t possible. 

I then told him that he’s had two weeks to surprise me. I wasn’t expecting anything huge or extravagant. Just some flowers would have been nice. I said everyday for the past two weeks when i come home to nothing, of course i lose faith in him a little bit each time. 

Now i feel bad because i feel like i came across too harsh. I know he loves me and he’s excited for me but he’s busy. AITAH?

Title: I'm just gonna come out and say it, I am the asshole but need help
Post Content:
Hi, I'm new to Reddit and I'm not sure if this is the right place to post this but I have a problem and really need help.

A few months ago a doctor told me that it's possible I may have a mood disorder during the time I was speaking to a therapist. He wrote in a prescription for me for my mood swings but the medicine isn't helping any. I took the medicine for about a few days but nothing has change and it feels the same, so I stopped taking it but my mood swings have been getting worse.

I feel like my mood swings are not only affecting my relationship with my boyfriend and baby, but also my work life as well. Literally the moment I walk into work I'm in a bitchy mood all day and I'm rude to customers whether they do something to purposely piss me off or not. A customer could ask me a simple question and I wouldn't want them to talk to me. I'm afraid that I'm affecting my relationship with my baby too. Anytime he throws a fit and I get really upset with him and say things I don't mean and become frustrated. I would even sometimes wish he wasn't born and that I hate being a mother. I swear to ya'll I wouldn't mean the things I say to him. I love my baby with all my heart and love being a mother and scares me to death is that he would grow up and become distant even though he's just one now. My boyfriend is very supportive and understands my situation but I'm that one I would drive him away with my constant mood swings.

He would say a harmless joke or would do small things like leave a cup in the sink and I would get really upset. For some reason my mind would think back on the times where he has said and did hurtful things and I would absolutely hate him for it even he apologized and we moved on from that stuff. Those things would always come back to my mind and it would fuck up my entire day. That's a reason my mood would constant change too.

I did speak to a therapist a few months ago as I mentioned but honestly she wasn't really good therapist. She would put her personal opinions to the conversations making me feel more shitty than I already am. So I stopped talking to her and have been thinking about speaking to another since. But in my area, medical professionals and therapists aren't that great.

My mood has been getting worse and I'm that I might get fired from my job even when I need my job more than anything right now and can't afford to lose it.

Someone please give my advice on what to do. Please recommend a therapist or just tell me how to fix this. What are some good therapy apps or medicine I should take. I know this was a lot but I really need help.
